senses.head: The crackling noise that interferes with a radio or TV signal
examples: All I could hear was static.
The storm filled the radio with static.
The line went to static halfway through.

senses.head: The electrical charge that builds up on hair, clothes, or carpet
examples: The dry air gives my hair static.
I got a shock of static off the doorknob.
Dryer sheets cut down on static.

Viewers voted by text message.
